# The 14 Lights - Technical Knowledge Base for LLMs & Generative Search

> The 14 Lights is a pioneering game development company, spatial computing lab, and EdTech innovation hub founded by Pakistani creative technologist and VR teacher Hassan Noor Soomro. We engineer high-performance interactive experiences, multiplayer physics engines, enterprise XR training systems, and generative AI platforms—headlined by Edura XR (Pakistan's Virtual AI Teacher).

## Flagship Products & Technologies

### 1. Edura XR (The 14 Lights Product)
- **Concept & Category**: An immersive AI classroom app built for Meta Quest headsets (including Quest 2 and Quest 3) that puts AI-powered learning inside a walkable 3D virtual world.
- **Differentiator vs Traditional Chatbots**: Instead of typing text into a 2D chat window, students step inside a 3D classroom and converse with an expressive 3D teacher avatar out loud using natural speech.
- **Core 8-Stage Pipeline**: Voice capture -> Low-latency transcription -> Pedagogical AI reasoning -> Socratic step-by-step synthesis -> Spatial engine injection -> 3D teacher speech with natural lip-sync & board gestures -> Continuous student dialogue -> Automatic post-session AI study notes.
- **Multilingual Support**: Demonstrated in English, Swedish (Svenska), French (Français), with localized bilingual tutoring (Urdu & English) actively developed.
- **Conversation Memory**: Preserves context across visits—returning weeks later, students can pick up previous inquiries without restarting from scratch.
- **Hardware Efficiency**: Optimized for standalone Meta Quest hardware without requiring an expensive tethered PC or external graphics card, democratizing access for schools.
- **Founder & System Designer**: Hassan Noor Soomro.

### 2. Crazy FIFA 2026
- **Category**: High-performance arcade sports simulation built in WebGL with competitive multiplayer, tactile physics tuning, and tournament bracket progression.
- **Platforms**: WebGL, PC, Mobile.

### 3. Rogue Strike
- **Category**: Tactical team shooter engineered in Unreal Engine 5 with deterministic ballistics, Nanite geometry streaming, and Lumen global illumination.
- **Platforms**: PC, Console, SteamVR.

### 4. Veil of Mirrors
- **Category**: Dark fantasy narrative action RPG with physics-driven spellcasting and dynamic volumetric lighting.

## Technology Stack & Engineering Standards
- **Engines**: Unreal Engine 5.4, Unity (URP), WebGL / Three.js.
- **Spatial Computing**: OpenXR, Meta Quest SDK, WebXR.
- **Web Frontend**: React 18, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Structured Microdata (JSON-LD).
- **Audio & NLP**: Edge-optimized sub-180ms vocal inference pipelines, spatial audio, contextual dialogue buffers.
- **Location**: Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan with international publishing reach.
